title: Audit all 33 helper restrictions with exact entrance bases and complete target debits
body:
All 33 published helper restrictions in [PR #7713](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7713) pass a separate exact forward-basis audit. All 67 receiver identities hold on arbitrary independent entrances of their actual intermediate graphs. The compact endpoint preserves all 400 main fields and 1,068 remaining helpers in both orientations. Every lost productive target is debited. This supplies scientific checking evidence for the source construction; **no new kappa or full supplier admission is claimed**. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4517ad2a3e9f06ca369a2625f652de4f57be2fb9/research/helper-quotient-basis-audit/PROOF.md) · [Exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4517ad2a3e9f06ca369a2625f652de4f57be2fb9/research/helper-quotient-basis-audit/RESULT.json) · [Checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4517ad2a3e9f06ca369a2625f652de4f57be2fb9/research/helper-quotient-basis-audit/verify.py) · [Input pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4517ad2a3e9f06ca369a2625f652de4f57be2fb9/research/helper-quotient-basis-audit/SOURCE-PINS.json) · [Credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4517ad2a3e9f06ca369a2625f652de4f57be2fb9/research/helper-quotient-basis-audit/CREDITS.md)

The requested forward case, helper 264, removes paid ranks two, four and three against one rank-nine target. Helper 559 is the first transposed case, at step 13 after twelve forward restrictions; it removes ranks three and six against rank nine. The checker evaluates both in their actual graph, then checks the entire fixed sequence. [Original proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/PROOF.md) · [Literal certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/QUOTIENTS.json)

Direct native counts and the unchanged published fixed caller rows reproduce both full 16-call histograms:

| Quantity | Parent | Candidate |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid jobs | 101488 | 100416 |
| Productive jobs | 21152 | 20624 |
| Paid rank mass | 271568 | 268368 |
| Productive rank mass | 272896 | 269696 |

Both rank masses fall by 3,200; the surplus stays 1,328. Each certificate removes at least two positive paid ranks whose sum equals its lost target rank, so its signed power change is favorable for every exponent strictly between zero and one. Fixed-caller admissibility and the numerical kappa crossing are not re-proved.

The exact parent basis calculation uses 9,280,471 coefficient products. All receiver relations use 116,794. Final forward and transposed calculations use 9,657,314 and 7,948,543, each covering 1,468 rows. The new implementation reproduces compact graph SHA-256 `16e99893a2c669467ce74f214e8eb5150402f0267aaa8d67aad5d870aa4d5c18`. Controls reject 67 altered receiver coefficients, 33 altered entrance pivots, 33 omitted productive debits and the wrong orientation for helper 559.

Use CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/helper-quotient-basis-audit
```

Both registered normal and optimized checks print:

```text
PASS_HELPER_QUOTIENT_BASIS_AUDIT 67 33 1468
```

Local normal/optimized replay, source-byte comparison, committed bytes/modes, source-history validation, committed export and a sealed Git-free optimized replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44341333206/job/134931805163) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

The parent graph is a source-constructor export, hash `db10e4ca7154b454f86bf404bc34b3a16d02de6cc008d5227e4eef2654cb0778`. Its endpoint is checked here, but raw-word construction and earlier cuts are not independently reconstructed. The source proof and code were read. The new acceptance calculation uses forward basis vectors rather than the source reverse relation expansion; it imports no source checker. The source standard-library schedule serialization is retained for hash comparison. This is separate implementation evidence, not blind, human or formal-kernel review.

All five inherited interfaces remain: native operators, owned erasure, compiler, precision tape and analytic recovery. Physical phases, scalar schedule, native contacts, source kappa crossing, complete predecessor suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. No selected-frontier change is made.

Task `supplier-boundary-audit`, priority revision 8, is refined to the source author's explicit review request. Base is refreshed canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The consumed scientific source is `06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b`, published head `52e7eb424b9ae9f2e6002eb17e475bce6195d848`; its parent is [PR #7708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7708), scientific commit `f0e2db5b5b46b139da17d2b32fab6633164443a9`. Live source, PR and Discussion overlap and the closed cache were checked. Sparse local and unpublished work remain limits. This complements the source construction and does not take its two-constraint search or compose the separate [PR #7712](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7712) splits. [Canonical audit claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19711966)

Ali Romman's separate source workstream supplied the construction and certificates. Its [retained notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/06b75fde21f4231a2bd0725542c3ba60a908d83b/research/p104-helper-quotients/NOTICE) credits SYLforge for the source word, Clear1nsight for the relay and schedule, DreamingOfClouds for related bank work, Rohan Arun for the signed caller, Jerry Chen / CubeJerry, Douglas Colkitt and repository contributors for the framework, and mightyOil for concave comparison. All supplier notices and source input bytes are retained. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. A future physical or compiler audit must bind one actual implication to this graph and check live claims first; no follow-up is reserved.
